spec.query:
SELECT sum("flow_actual") / 60 AS "water"
FROM "dongtien_realtime"
WHERE
    "machine"::tag = 'Lưu lượng hơi tổng'
    AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($d_interval), "shift"::tag, "machine"::tag
fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "electricity_measurement" WHERE ("name"::tag = 'Tổng Ca 6h') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "name"::tag fill(none)

SELECT SUM("hourly_production") AS "production"
FROM (
    SELECT integral("ton_per_min", 1m) AS "hourly_production"
    FROM (
        SELECT
            (
                mean("speed_reel") *
                4.6 *
                mean("basic_weight") *
                0.97
            ) / 1000000 AS "ton_per_min"
        FROM "dongtien_realtime"
        WHERE
            "machine" = 'PM6'
            AND $timeFilter
        GROUP BY time(1m)
        fill(none)
    )
    GROUP BY time(1h)
    fill(0)
)
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($d_interval)
fill(none)

SELECT sum("hourly_consumption") AS "water_consumption"

  SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"),1h) AS "hourly_consumption"

  GROUP BY time(1h), "name"::tag fill(none)
)
WHERE $timeFilter
